page: Microsoft Azure E64bds_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores using an Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It includes 2458 GB of local SSD storage and supports Premium Storage for high block storage performance. No GPUs are present in this configuration.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core performance, with high ratings in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, Geekbench multi-core tests, and Passmark CPU suites. Memory performance is robust, showing top-tier bandwidth for large-block uncached reads and writes. Database operations and Redis SET operations perform exceptionally well, alongside high throughput for static web serving. Single-core performance and text processing benchmarks fall within average ranges, while large-scale LLM text generation represents a performance bottleneck.

The E64bds_v5 offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads by bundling a substantial 2.4 TB local SSD and 512 GB of RAM with its 64 vCPUs, reducing the need for separate high-performance storage attachments. This configuration is highly suited for large relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, software compilation pipelines, and data-intensive web serving applications.
